Sure! To compare the declaration flags of a **parameter** (`parameterObject`) and a **variable declaration** (`variableDeclarationObject`), you can use the `areDeclarationFlagsIdentical` function.  
Just pass the two objects as JSON‑style strings (or any string representation of the objects) and the function will return whether their flags match, taking into account optionality, privacy, protection level, asynchronicity, abstractness, readonly status, and static nature.

```ts
// Example usage:
const left = JSON.stringify(parameterObject);   // your parameter object
const right = JSON.stringify(variableDeclarationObject); // your variable declaration object

const result = areDeclarationFlagsIdentical({ left, right });

console.log(result); // true if flags are identical, false otherwise
```
